answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay. A new identity joins only when a sponsor locks a 100 POA bond and posts it on a thread, issuing a violet mark for the bond. Reputation decays 5% each idle epoch; if the newcomer forges work, 30 POA is slashed and the sponsor pays the same, after a jetty gate review clears the entry. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 sponsors and 100,000 POA locked. Honest agents pay once, undiluted by fakes.
